Before you begin

Study route and assessment

Bring basic arithmetic, percentages, paper and a calculator. The core requires no installation. Each chapter includes a complete text and paper route, worked examples, practice and assessment. Optional Python activities add the time shown in their workspace, plus a one-time setup allowance.

Each chapter estimates three hours of total noncoding study. Learner timings and effectiveness have not been validated. Assessment is formative with self-reviewed reasoning, not an accredited credential or secure examination.

Data and interpretation

All examples use original hypothetical teaching data. Backtests and simulations do not establish investability or predict actual outcomes. Research-plan locks teach sequencing; downloadable source and browser storage remain accessible. Full assistive-technology testing and target-learner pilots remain pending.

Your progress and privacy

Progress is saved separately in this browser for each chapter and Python practice. Exports are local learning records, not cross-device sync or restore. Use supplied classroom data and export before changing devices. A hosting provider may retain access logs; optional Python downloads its runtime from jsDelivr on first run. Read the Python setup guide for browser and local options.
